echo "[brace words after default splitting]"

echo "[empty list fields are removed]"

compgen -W 'c b d a'

echo "[Take 1]"

echo "[Take 2]"
compgen -W 'foo bar' -X 'f*' ''

echo "[Take 3]"
compgen -W '&1 foo' -X '\&*' ''

compgen -W 'foo bar fab' -X '!f*' ''

compgen -W 'foo bar' -X '!z*' ''
echo "rc=$?"

echo "[Take 1]"
compgen -W 'somebody something' -X '&b*' some
compgen -k

PATH=/nonexistent
compgen -A command -- do
for w in $(compgen -A command -- f); do
  case $w in fi|for|function) echo "$w" ;; esac
done
compgen -A helptopic whil

compgen -W 'fo"o'; echo "rc=$?"
compgen -W 'fo"o bar'; echo "rc=$?"
compgen -W 'fo"o bar' -- f; echo "rc=$?"
compgen -W "a 'b c"; echo "rc=$?"
# A backslash left dangling at the end is dropped, except in single quotes.
word='fo"o\'; compgen -W "$word"; echo "rc=$?"
word='fo\'; compgen -W "$word"; echo "rc=$?"
word="fo'o\\"; compgen -W "$word"; echo "rc=$?"

set -u
compgen -W '$nope'; echo "rc=$?"
echo next

complete -W foo mycmd
complete

complete -W foo mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -W 'foo bar' mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -P myprefix mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -P 'my prefix' mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -W x cmd
compopt -o nospace +o nospace cmd
complete -p cmd
compopt +o nospace -o nospace cmd
complete -p cmd
compopt -o nospace +o filenames -o filenames cmd
complete -p cmd

complete -S mysuffix mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -S 'my suffix' mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -Fmyfunc mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -G pattern mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -G 'pat tern' mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -X pattern mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -X 'pat tern' mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -C cmd mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete -C 'c md' mycmd
complete -p mycmd

for action in alias arrayvar binding builtin command directory disabled enabled export file 'function' group helptopic hostname job keyword running service setopt shopt signal stopped user variable; do
  complete -A ${action} mycmd
  complete -p mycmd
done

complete -o nospace -o filenames -W x mycmd
compopt +o nospace mycmd; echo "rc=$?"
complete -p

complete -W x -- +cmd -cmd
compopt -o nospace -- +cmd -cmd; echo "rc=$?"
complete -p -- +cmd -cmd

echo "[Removing non-existent]"
complete -r nonexistent
echo $?

echo "[Removing existing]"
complete -W token mycmd
complete -r mycmd
echo $?
complete -p mycmd 2>/dev/null

complete -W token mycmd1
complete -W token mycmd2

complete -r
echo $?

complete -p

complete -W token mycmd
complete -W other -E

complete -r -E
echo $?

complete -p

complete -v -o nospace -A function -a -o default -F fn -G '*.c' -W 'w1 w2' -X '*.x' -P pre -S suf -C cmd mycmd
complete -p mycmd
complete -A signal -A arrayvar -b -a -A builtin other
complete -p other
complete -X '*.y' -W x 'a b'
complete -p 'a b'

complete -o filenames -A function -X '*.x' -P pre -W 'w1 w2' mycmd
complete -D -X '*.y' -F fn
before=$(complete -p mycmd; complete -p -D)
complete -r
eval "$before"
after=$(complete -p mycmd; complete -p -D)
echo "$after"
[[ $before == "$after" ]] && echo "round-tripped"

complete -F '#fn' -W x '~'
complete -F a,b cmd1
complete -F fn 'a,b'
before=$(complete -p '~' cmd1 'a,b')
echo "$before"
complete -r
eval "$before"
after=$(complete -p '~' cmd1 'a,b')
[[ $before == "$after" ]] && echo "round-tripped"
compgen -W "a b a c b"
compgen -W "z y x a"

complete -f -X '!*.txt' mycmd
complete -p mycmd

complete
complete -W 'foo bar' mycommand
complete -p
complete -F myfunc other
complete -W "it's" q
complete -p other q

complete -o nospace -o default -A function -a -v -G '*.c' -W 'a b' -X '!x' -P pre -S suf -F fn -C cmd -A setopt x
complete -p x

complete -D -F f
complete -E -W e
complete -p -D
complete -p -E

complete -F f
echo status=$?
complete -p nosuch
echo status=$?
complete -r nosuch
echo status=$?
complete foo
echo status=$?
complete -r foo
complete -p
echo done

compgen -A foo
echo status=$?
compgen -o bogus -W x
echo status=$?

compopt -o invalid
echo status=$?
compopt -o filenames +o nospace
echo status=$?
complete -W x c1
compopt -o nospace c1
complete -p c1

compgen -W 'one two three'
echo --
compgen -W 'aa ab b' -P '<' -S '>' a
echo --
compgen -W 'aa ab' -X '&b' a

IFS=':%'
compgen -W '$(echo "spam:eggs%ham cheese")'
compgen -W 'x:y%z w\:v'

compgen -W '${'
echo status=$?
compgen -W 'foo $(( 1 / 0 )) bar'
echo status=$?
compgen -W '' -- foo
echo status=$?

export v1_global=0
unexported=1
f() { local v2_local=0; export v2_local; compgen -e v; }
f
compgen -e unexported
echo status=$?
complete -W x cmd; (complete -W child cmd; complete -p cmd); complete -p cmd
complete -W x cmd; compopt cmd; compopt -o nospace cmd; compopt cmd
compgen; printf "status=%s\n" "$?"; compgen -Z; printf "status=%s\n" "$?"
complete -W "a'b" "#command"; complete -p '#command'
compgen -W 'a b' -P '<' -S '>' -X '!a'
compgen -v zz_completion; zz_completion_a=x; zz_completion_b=y; compgen -v zz_completion; compgen -A arrayvar zz_completion; exit 0
compgen -u definitely_missing_runtime_user; printf "status=%s\n" "$?"
compgen -b comp; compgen -k do
complete -W x -D -E -I; complete -p -D -E -I; complete -r -D -E -I; complete -p -D; printf 'status=%s\n' "$?"
complete -W x z a q b c d k mycmd1 mycmd2 cmd; complete -p; complete -W replaced z; complete -p
complete -W d -D; complete -W e -E; complete -W i -I; complete -W x cmd z a; complete -p

mkdir completion-files; printf x >completion-files/one; printf x >completion-files/two; mkdir completion-files/three; compgen -f completion-files/one; compgen -d completion-files/th; compgen -G 'completion-files/t*' ignored

mkdir completion-options; mkdir completion-options/dir; printf x >completion-options/file; compgen -W '' -o default completion-options/f; compgen -W '' -o dirnames completion-options/d; compgen -W x -o plusdirs completion-options/d
printf x >completion-glob-file; compgen -W 'completion-*'; compgen -W 'a* literal' -X 'a*'; compgen -W 'one two' -X '!@(one|other)'
IFS=,; compgen -W 'a b,c\,d,e;f'; IFS=; compgen -W 'a b'; compgen -W ''
x='alpha beta'; compgen -W '$x'; compgen -W '"$x"'; compgen -W '$(printf "z y\n")'; compgen -W '$((2+3))'
compgen -A signal; compgen -A signal 3; echo status:$?
mkdir completion-default; printf x >completion-default/file; compgen -o bashdefault completion-default/f; echo status:$?; compgen -o default completion-default/f
printf x >zz_file; compgen -o default -W '' -P '<' -S '>' zz_
mkdir zz_dir; compgen -W 'zz_word' -o plusdirs -P '<' -S '>' zz_
mkdir zz_dir; compgen -W '' -o dirnames -P '<' -S '>' zz_
mkdir zz_dir; printf x >zz_file; compgen -c ./zz_
compgen -W '$(case x in x) printf "a b";; esac) c'; echo status:$?
compgen -W "$'a b' x"; compgen -W "$'a\\tb' x"
printf '127.0.0.1 zz_custom_hostname zz_alias\n' >zz_hosts; HOSTFILE=$PWD/zz_hosts compgen -A hostname zz_
compgen -W 'a b 1' -X '[[:alpha:]]'; echo status:$?
shopt -s extglob; printf x >zz_one; printf x >zz_two; compgen -G 'zz_@(one|two)'; echo status:$?
HOME=$PWD; printf x >zz_file; compgen -f '~/zz_'; compgen -d '~/zz_'; echo status:$?
compgen -W "$'a\nb' x"; compgen -W "$'a\x41b' x"; compgen -W "$'a\\b' x"; compgen -W "$'a\'b' x"
compgen -W '"$a" $"a b"'; compgen -W '$(case x in (x) case y in y) printf "a b";; esac;; esac) c'
mkdir zz_dir; printf x >zz_file; compgen -W 'zz_word' -o plusdirs -P '<' -S '>' -X '!zz_word' zz_
printf x >zz_file; compgen -o default -W 'zz_word' -P '<' -S '>' zz_; compgen -o default -W 'zz_word' -X '*' -P '<' -S '>' zz_
mkdir -p zz_dir/inner; printf x >zz_plain; compgen -c ./zz_; compgen -c ./zz_dir/i; PATH=$PWD compgen -c zz_
HOME=$PWD; mkdir zz_dir; printf x >zz_file; compgen -d '~/zz_'; compgen -c '~/zz_'; HOME=missing compgen -f '~/zz_'; echo status:$?
for pattern in '[[:digit:]]' '[![:alpha:]]' '[[:upper:][:digit:]]' '[x[:lower:]]' '[[:xdigit:]]' '[[:notaclass:]]'; do compgen -W 'a b Z x 1 7 +' -X "$pattern"; done
compgen -W 'é β A 1' -X '[[:alpha:]]'; compgen -W 'a b 1' -X '![[:alpha:]]'; compgen -W ': a 1' -X '[\[:alpha:]]'

' > /etc/services; compgen -A service zz_
